verdict.rationale: Netlify is a hosting platform, so asking whether it publishes an uptime SLA with defined downtime credits is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an SLA, uptime commitments, or service credits. DDoS protection, analytics, and billing complaints are adjacent topics and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can review a published uptime SLA with defined credits for downtime
